errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are at 6-month intervals (Januar, Juli), not 12 months.
The line representing the real minimum wage is purple, not red.
The legend for the minimum wage is "Realer Mindestlohn, HVPI-basierter Index (Januar 2015 = 100)". The description incorrectly includes "Stundenbasis" and omits the reference period "Januar 2015".

The real minimum wage line ends at an index value of approximately 110 in January 2025, not 105. The description also fails to mention the significant jump in value around January 2023 from ~98 to ~112.
All lines in the chart are solid, not dashed (gestrichelte).

The chart contains three distinct lines. The description fails to mention the light blue line for "Arbeitsproduktivität auf Stundenbasis (Index, 1. Quartal 2015 = 100)" and incorrectly conflates the two productivity lines into a single "blaue Linie".
